messages:
Harper: FYI — Nimbus Labs says they completed an ACH payment yesterday but their org was suspended and dunning emails kept going out. They uploaded the payment confirmation + PO to the support ticket. Can @Kevin (Finance) take a look? This is blocking their prod usage.

Kevin (Finance): Got it, can you paste the payment reference / bank settlement id and invoice number so I can check the ledger?

Harper: Sure — pasted below from the customer attachment: 
```
customer: Nimbus Labs
invoice: INV-9876
amount: $14,200.00
payment_method: ACH
settlement_id: SETT-84571234
date_received: 2025-11-04
po_number: PO-55321
bank_ref: 20251104-NTB
```

Billing Bot: Notice: account nimbus-prod suspended for non-payment after 3 failed attempts. Dunning email sequence started 2025-11-05.

Kevin (Finance): I see SETT-84571234 in the incoming settlements feed. Amount matches INV-9876. It looks like the settlement posted after the dunning job ran and auto-suspended the org. I'll mark the invoice reconciled and remove from collections. Adding note FIN-4523.

Harper: Confirmed invoice match on our side too. The customer also attached a bank remittance PDF in the ticket.

Kevin (Finance): Done — invoice INV-9876 marked PAID, cleared in ledger, removed from collections queue. @Maya can you lift the service suspension for org nimbus-prod (org id nimbus-123)? Please confirm once restored so I can close FIN-4523.

Maya (Ops): On it. Will perform manual unsuspend and confirm once background jobs re-run. ETA ~5-10m.

Maya (Ops): Unsuspend complete. Health checks look good, keys working, no enqueue backlog. Re-run of infra sync triggered.

Harper: Customer just replied in the support ticket — access restored, services returning to normal. I'll send them a confirmation email and attach FIN-4523 + remittance note.

Kevin (Finance): Thanks. I've added the reconciliation note and linked the PO. Also set a flag to prevent auto-suspend for 24h while we wait for bank clearing to finalize.

Harper: Great — closing the loop from CS. Leaving a public note on the ticket with the bank ref and manual reinstatement steps for future reference. :white_check_mark:

Maya (Ops): If you want, I can add a short runbook entry for 'post-settlement unsuspend' so on-call knows steps next time.

Harper: Please do, that would help. Thanks everyone :tada:
